<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/projects/{projectId}/stories/{storyId}/return"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



The story leaves the proposal queue and the reason becomes a message pinned to the PO's session — the same pattern as returning a gate to dev. If that session's PO is no longer up, the return is recorded anyway: it's the user's decision and does not depend on an agent listening.
